scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-blender-worker.mjs && node scripts/runtime-build-manifest.mjs --write
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run docs:check && npm run authoring:anti-leak && npm run visual:architecture:check && npm run rojo:check && npm run runtime-build:check && node --test dist/test/world-compiler.test.js dist/test/world-family-resolver.test.js dist/test/hierarchical-world.test.js dist/test/studio-bridge.test.js dist/test/neural-family-factory.test.js dist/test/basalt-constraints.test.js && npm run plugin:test
scripts.plugin:test: find plugin/src -name '*.luau' -print0 | xargs -0 luau-compile --only-parse && node scripts/check-plugin-ui.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run plugin:build
